title: A dungeon crawl where each room is a basic electronics puzzle
summary: A playful session: move room to room, solve basic electronics puzzles, earn the next door.

blocks.title: You wake up in the Ohmworks Crypt
blocks.body: Torches flicker. Each door opens only when you solve the room's electronics puzzle. No dragons — just Kirchhoff, LEDs, and one slightly judgmental multimeter golem. Play in order.

blocks.title: Party rules
blocks.body: One attempt mindset: read the room text, then answer the exercise. Wrong answers still teach — the golem sighs, then explains. Fictional dungeon; real circuit ideas.

blocks.heading: Room 1 — Resistor Bridge
blocks.body: Two resistors in series across a 12 V torch battery: 3 kΩ on top, 1 kΩ on bottom. The door sensor reads the middle node. What voltage does it see (ideal, unloaded)?

blocks.heading: Puzzle 1
blocks.prompt: 12 V across 3 kΩ then 1 kΩ to ground. V at the middle node?
blocks.explanation: Divider: Vout = Vin × Rbottom / (Rtop + Rbottom) = 12 × (1/4) = 3 V.
blocks.correctFeedback: The stone door grinds open. The golem nods once.
blocks.wrongFeedback: The golem points at the divider formula: Vout = Vin × Rbottom / (Rtop+Rbottom).

blocks.heading: Room 2 — LED Shrine
blocks.body: A red LED wants about 2 V forward and 10 mA. Your supply is 5 V. You must pick a series resistor from the altar tray.

blocks.heading: Puzzle 2
blocks.prompt: Approx series resistor for 5 V supply, 2 V LED, 10 mA?
blocks.explanation: Voltage across resistor ≈ 5 − 2 = 3 V. R = V/I = 3 / 0.01 = 300 Ω.
blocks.correctFeedback: The LED blazes to life; the shrine door unlocks.
blocks.wrongFeedback: Subtract LED Vf from the supply, then Ohm's law for 10 mA.

blocks.heading: Room 3 — Node Cavern
blocks.body: Three tunnels meet at a node. Into the node: 20 mA from the north. Out to the east: 7 mA. The south tunnel's current is unknown. KCL says the currents must balance.

blocks.heading: Puzzle 3
blocks.prompt: If 20 mA enters and 7 mA leaves east, what must leave south (no other paths)?
blocks.explanation: KCL: sum in = sum out → 20 = 7 + Isouth → Isouth = 13 mA.
blocks.correctFeedback: The cavern bridge solidifies. You cross.
blocks.wrongFeedback: What enters a node must leave — solve for the missing outflow.

blocks.heading: Room 4 — Capacitance Vault
blocks.body: A 1 µF capacitor charges through 1 kΩ toward 5 V. The vault door cracks open near one time constant, when the capacitor has climbed roughly 63% of the way.

blocks.heading: Puzzle 4
blocks.prompt: τ = R×C for 1 kΩ and 1 µF is:
blocks.correctFeedback: The vault sighs open on schedule.

blocks.heading: Boss door — the Golem's riddle
blocks.body: The golem blocks the exit with a series LED circuit on a 9 V battery: LED Vf ≈ 2 V, target ≈ 10 mA, plus a divider question whispered as distraction. Stay focused on the resistor you need for the LED branch.

blocks.heading: Boss puzzle
blocks.prompt: 9 V battery, LED Vf 2 V, want ~10 mA series current. Closest resistor?
blocks.correctFeedback: The golem steps aside. Daylight. You have escaped the Ohmworks Crypt.
blocks.wrongFeedback: Same LED method as Room 2: (Vsupply − Vf) / I.

blocks.heading: Session complete
blocks.body: Replay with friends: one reads the room, one owns the multimeter, everyone argues kindly before locking an answer.
